svg.title: TurboWin+ CI tasks (GitHub Actions and GitLab)

g.text: TurboWin+ CI tasks (GitHub Actions and GitLab)
GitHub: separate workflows; JAR uses workflow_dispatch.
GitLab: one build stage; JAR is manual.
Email build settings required; dummy fallbacks only in GitHub test.
No signing or release-publication stage is implemented.
video, log, HTML and XML reports.
